item.title: Without Breaking the Seal: Closing a Security Hole with FUOTA
item.description: A security hole we spotted over a coffee break, 1,900 already-shipped devices and a pile of unopened boxes. How the code I liked least ended up saving me, two computers with two different BLE personalities, and 160 devices in one afternoon.
